# Manifest

> Supercharge HTML for rapid, feature-rich website and web app development.

## Overview

- [The website & app framework that thinks like you do. — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/): Manifest is an HTML-native runtime with routing, components, reactive data, localization, and an optional cloud backend built in — no build step required.

## Docs

- [Introduction — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/getting-started/introduction): A website and app framework built directly into HTML. No bundler, no build step, no boilerplate.
- [Setup — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/getting-started/setup): Get Manifest with CDN links or copied from GitHub.
- [Starter Project — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/getting-started/starter-project): Kickstart new websites and apps with a turnkey template.
- [Compatibility — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/getting-started/compatibility): Designed to work in all major browsers.
- [Accessibility — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/getting-started/accessibility): Allow your project to support all audiences.
- [Chat — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/chat): Add conversations with AI or people to your project.
- [Components — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/components): Reusable HTML templates with route-bound rendering.
- [Export — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/export): Download the page, a region, or a data source as a file.
- [Local Data — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/local-data): Load YAML, JSON, or CSV files as reactive data sources.
- [Localization — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/localization): Localize your project to different languages and regions.
- [Markdown — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/markdown): Render markdown files into HTML with syntax highlighting and frontmatter.
- [Payments — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/payments): Integrate payment providers with your project.
- [Resize — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/resize): Make any HTML element resizable with drag handles.
- [Router — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/router): Set page navigation paths in your project.
- [Status — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/status): Track the health of your services and display it with $status.
- [URL Parameters — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/url-parameters): Display content with modified URL strings.
- [Virtual — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/core-plugins/virtual): Render long lists, tables, grids, and galleries efficiently with windowed scrolling.
- [Appwrite Setup — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/appwrite-plugins/appwrite-setup): Use Appwrite to turn Manifest projects into production-ready applications.
- [Auth — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/appwrite-plugins/auth): Implement a complete authentication solution for your app with a connected Appwrite project.
- [Users — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/appwrite-plugins/users): Enable guests and user accounts in your project.
- [Teams — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/appwrite-plugins/teams): Allow users to work together within your application.
- [Cloud Data — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/appwrite-plugins/cloud-data): Access Appwrite databases and storage with the same $x API as local data.
- [Databases — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/appwrite-plugins/databases): Query and manage Appwrite database tables.
- [Storage — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/appwrite-plugins/storage): Upload, view, and download files from Appwrite storage buckets.
- [Presence — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/appwrite-plugins/presence): Show who
- [Testing — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/publishing/testing): Verify project readiness with automated testing.
- [Websites — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/publishing/websites): Publish Manifest projects live to the web.
- [SEO & AEO — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/publishing/seo-aeo): Help search engines and AI crawlers find, understand, and rank your site.
- [Web Apps — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/publishing/web-apps): Turn a Manifest project into an installable progressive web app (PWA).
- [Native Apps — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/publishing/native-apps): Package a Manifest project as a native app for app stores or direct download.
- [Reset — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/styles/reset): Normalize styles for consistent rendering across browsers.
- [Theme — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/styles/theme): Global colors, spacing, typography, and more via CSS custom properties.
- [Color Modes — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/styles/color-modes): Apply light, dark, and system color modes.
- [Utilities — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/styles/utilities): Maintain visual consistency with common utility classes.
- [Accordions — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/accordions): Collapsible content panels that expand on demand.
- [Avatars — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/avatars): User profile images with status indicators and fallbacks.
- [Badges — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/badges): Compact labels for status, counts, and tags.
- [Buttons — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/buttons): Interactive elements that trigger actions.
- [Charts — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/charts): Reactive SVG charts, from simple sparklines to live dashboards.
- [Checkboxes — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/checkboxes): Form controls for selecting one or more options.
- [Code — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/code): Syntax-highlighted code elements using standard HTML, with numerous configurable options.
- [Color Pickers — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/color-pickers): Visual color selection with Hex, RGB, HSL, and OKLCH inputs.
- [Comboboxes — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/comboboxes): Collect entries or chips in filterable fields.
- [Date Pickers — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/date-pickers): Calendar dates, ranges, and times with native fallbacks and full localization.
- [Dialogs — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/dialogs): Modal and non-modal overlays for focused interactions.
- [Dividers — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/dividers): Horizontal and vertical lines for visual separation.
- [Dropdowns — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/dropdowns): Anchored menus for actions and selections.
- [Forms — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/forms): Structured input layouts with built-in validation.
- [Icons — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/icons): Inline SVG icons from Iconify via the x-icon directive.
- [Inputs — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/inputs): Single-line text fields with validation states.
- [Radios — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/radios): Form controls for selecting one option from a group.
- [Ranges — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/ranges): Sliders for numeric input with optional steps.
- [Selects — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/selects): OS-native dropdown lists for choosing options.
- [Sidebars — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/sidebars): Collapsible navigation panels anchored to a viewport edge.
- [SVGs — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/svgs): Inline vector graphics with reactive styling.
- [Switches — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/switches): Binary toggle controls with on/off states.
- [Tables — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/tables): Structured layouts for tabular data with grid and striped variants.
- [Tabs — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/tabs): Sectioned content with switchable panels.
- [Textareas — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/textareas): Multi-line text fields with auto-resize and validation.
- [Toasts — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/toasts): Transient notifications anchored to the viewport.
- [Tooltips — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/tooltips): Hover and focus hints for inline annotations.
- [Typography — Manifest](https://manifestx.dev/docs/elements/typography): Heading, paragraph, and inline text styling.
